_notes: Every world's planetside map, the 4x map UQM 0.8.0's own GeneratePlanetSurface makes with TopoScale4x (plangen.c) on entering orbit from a new game, for worlds that are neither shielded nor gas giants. TopoScale4x draws on frandom, whose seed UQM starts at 0x12345678 when the program starts and never resets; here each world is run in a process of its own, so frandom starts afresh for each, as the engine does (docs/plans/stage-2b.md, decision 1). Code only, no content.
worlds: [star, planet, moon or -1, landable, SHA-256 of the (MAP_WIDTH * 4) x (MAP_HEIGHT * 4) signed bytes, row by row, or null].
